reviews.text: For Ares, it's a second home. The guys are all incredibly talented and have the extraordinary ability to read and understand all dogs. They care for them with great respect and adapt to their specific needs...because for them, it's truly not just a daycare center, it's a family, and it shows. Highly recommended 💯 for both daycare and boarding.

The only place I feel truly comfortable leaving my dog. ❤️
Knowing that Libero is in a safe environment, cared for and considered as an individual, with his own time, needs, and personality, really makes a difference.

I'm so happy I discovered the center, thanks to an owner who frequents the park where I take my dog. I'm very happy there, and I'm happy to publicly thank Rosario, Francesco, and Antonio, who are a source of inspiration for me and my dog, "Bruno." Anyone who has a dog knows how important it is to know who they spend time with. I'm incredibly happy when they're with them, whether they're boarding (like during the month of August) or at daycare, once a week. My dog ​​has a lot of energy, plays all day, and comes home exhausted but satisfied. The facility is very large, with nine fields, and is managed by highly competent people who are always ready to offer advice whenever needed. Thanks guys.

Happy to have discovered this center, with its qualified staff and kind hearts.
My GiraSole feels right at home.
I recommend it to everyone.
The guys are incredibly kind, helpful, and friendly; my dog ​​is always so happy to spend time there! They've also helped me with behavioral issues on numerous occasions.
They're open in August as a camp and boarding house when needed, which alone is a plus. Great kids, and my Totò always came back happy.

I highly recommend this center! I had a wonderful time, and thanks to them, I learned to know my Maremma better, to communicate with her, and to better understand her needs and behaviors. We did activities together that I never thought we'd be able to do, and every experience helped us grow and strengthen our relationship. A place where you can sense their expertise, passion, and love for dogs and animals in general 🐾❤️
A boxer isn't always easy to handle, but in this place we found humanity and professionalism to make her feel comfortable. It's an oasis.

Carletto's second home ❤️
Carletto is a daycare and boarding dog this summer, and knowing he can leave his dog in good hands and, above all, have fun makes me feel truly at peace.

Once you've met someone, you can't live without them!
Thanks to Antonio and with the support of Francesco and Rosario, my boyfriend and I are really getting to know each other, and amidst a whirlwind of emotions, we have the opportunity to grow, have fun, and relax in an oasis of well-being.

I've been frequenting this dog training center for a while, primarily for day walks and multi-day treks, and I can honestly say it's truly special.
The team is made up of competent, passionate, and always available people: you can immediately sense how much they care about the well-being of the dogs (and their humans 🙃!). Each outing is organized with care and professionalism, in a relaxed and positive atmosphere that puts everyone at ease.
During the excursions, whether short or multi-day, I've always felt in good hands. The routes are carefully chosen, and there's always great respect for the dogs, for nature, and for the group.
It's much more than just a service: it's become a point of reference, a place where you can grow together with your dog, having fun and sharing unique experiences.

Highly recommended!

Simba has been attending the center for 7 years and never was a choice more correct, an unmanageable dog, excluded from another center has become an adorable dog thanks to them, "dumb" has now become one of them, Antonio and Francesco were already perfect as is, but this year the arrival of Rosario has truly closed the circle. I would not entrust my "furry son" to anyone else, because I know that in addition to competence and ability, there is heart, that of those who love their work, after so many years we feel like we are part of a big family and today Simba is a happy dog, I attach the video of a normal day at nursery, Simba's joy, when Antonio comes to pick him up, is worth much more than a thousand words ❤️

I couldn't be happier with the dog training center! Holiver, my energetic Jack Russell, was welcomed with great professionalism, affection, and expertise. The staff is highly trained and passionate; they truly love what they do. The facility is clean, well-organized, and surrounded by greenery, perfect for making dogs feel at ease.

I arrived with Lilly, a lively puppy with the eagerness of someone who wants to give their dog the best. The best review comes from Lilly herself, who radiates joy when she arrives and sadness when she leaves. Thank you guys for your professionalism and expertise.
With gratitude
Roberto
Francesco and Antonio have been caring for my dog ​​ever since we got her, and they've been so sweet. Knowing she's in their care is a sure thing.

My Jack Russell, Loki, has been coming to this dog training center for years and couldn't be happier! The spaces are wonderful and constantly improving. The staff is kind, helpful, affectionate, and attentive to each dog's specific needs. They are also constantly training to offer new activities. I recommend it to anyone who wants to give their dogs and themselves authentic experiences.

I'm an old friend (I don't think I can call myself a customer)... my furry children (even those who are no longer with us 😢) have attended and attend this wonderful reality made of love and competence! Their commitment is total, they dedicate themselves carefully, also evaluating the different personalities of each dog, in this way they manage to educate each of them in the relationship with the other, even when, as in my case, one of my "children" feels he can dominate any of his peers! When I'm at the camp I feel completely calm, I recognize that they have fun but above all, knowing that they are able to handle dogs of any breed and size confirms their great professionalism! Once upon a time there was the wolf... always and forever, a phrase I use when I refer to someone who is and will always remain in my heart... and all of them are in my heart because true and loving people are rare in our world!!! ♥️♥️♥️

My experience has been truly positive. Despite her age, Mya, thanks in part to the work we've done with Antonio, has improved many of the management issues that used to plague us in our daily lives. Mya enjoys her days at the camp and is calm; she returns tired but happy. Even the taxi support, despite some changes, is currently a huge plus for us.
Once Upon a Time a Wolf is made up of skilled and professional people. I recommend them to anyone who wants to improve their dog's education and fully enjoy their time with him. 💓 …

We've been frequenting the center for four years now and will definitely continue to do so! The location, the services, and the professionalism of the entire team are a guarantee of well-being for our poodle Milla. With them, she's learned to socialize (with dogs and humans) and to experience being a dog in the wild. Highly recommended!!! ❤️

Meeting you was my lifesaver. You are a point of reference and a fundamental guide in the training and development of dogs, always attentive to their needs and, I would say, those of their owners as well!!! Your great sensitivity, in addition to your expertise, is your added value.

I think that for three years, my Teo, picked up and dropped off every Wednesday by the very kind Francesco, can't wait to go to daycare, where I think he has a blast, under the watchful eye of competent and attentive staff, who above all love our dogs dearly.
I thank all the staff and can only recommend everyone to try this experience for the good of their dogs.

My boys are always happy to come and play at your place, and all I have to say is "kindergarten" and they run for the door! 😂 This means that, in addition to the high level of professionalism, Milo and Pepe find a warm welcome and affection. Thanks to Francesco, Rosario, Daria, Chicca, and all the staff for the work they do. …

I've taken my husky Roy to several dog training centers, but I've never found the expertise, enthusiasm, professionalism, and helpfulness I found at Once Upon a Time a Wolf. Well done, guys, keep up the good work.

Porthos and I have known them for almost 6 years... Porthos was a puppy. They helped us as educators, friends... family. We started with kindergarten and ended up trekking in the mountains, always in wonderful places. Thanks to them, I discovered that Porthos loves the mountains and I do too, but that the mountains only have meaning with Porthos... thanks guys ❤️ I recommend him... in fact... highly recommend him
It was a very pleasant surprise to find such a pleasant place and people. A special mention goes to Chicca mamma superstar!

I left Leo, a Maltese with a sensitive stomach, for 16 days in August for the first time, and I have to say that Antonio, Rosario, and Francesco are exceptional people: attentive, thoughtful, and, above all, with a true love for dogs. They sent me photos and messages every day, keeping me updated on everything... I don't give a rating to those who truly love dogs, there's no need in this case, but if I really have to, 10 out of 10... thank you so much for everything.

I've been bringing my dog ​​Margot to this dog training camp for some time, and it's always a joy, both for her and for me. We've found competent, but above all passionate, people here, who know how to inspire trust and make every encounter a special occasion.

We've also taken several excursions and seminars with them, which have been incredibly enriching. They've been moments of discovery, sharing with other owners and dogs, and personal growth. Seeing Margot happy, curious, and engaged in these experiences has made all my efforts worthwhile.

For me, it's not just a place to "bring your dog," but an environment where you learn to build a true relationship, built on respect, listening, and understanding.

What can I say?
Professionalism and, above all, so much love for our furry friends.
Just look at our dog waiting for the super Kikka to come pick her up!!
Highly recommended
Well done guys!!

A reliable and well-organized dog training center.
My two dogs, Eva and Carolina, have been clients for years now. I have always had complete trust in them. We've done many courses, including training at home, away from home, agility, and nose work. We've also participated in numerous treks in fabulous locations like the Matese and Cervialto mountains (always accompanied by an expert guide). In short, for me, it's the best.

Finding such a well-maintained and professionally managed facility in the city is a dream for anyone needing to entertain their dogs. My English bulldogs had a wonderful time. Just steps from the Rione Alto, it feels like stepping into another world. Pristine nature, well-equipped and spotlessly clean fields, and highly competent staff. Special mention to Antonio. Thank you for everything.
Professional and competent staff! They are very attentive to your needs, I recommend them to everyone! Dogs can only love the total freedom and love they receive! ...Rosa

Anyone who walks their dog in the Rione Alto area recommends C'era Una Volta Un Lupo, and it's a no-brainer! The center is located just steps from Camaldoli and Vomero, and offers large, green spaces. Your dog will be eager to return! The …

A truly special place for dog lovers who want to offer them the best. Located in Rione Alto, this center stands out for the professionalism and passion of its staff, who are passionate about caring for and training our four-legged friends. …
